name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: D+19 district lean with strong fundamentals
Boyle's incumbency and $5.6M cash on hand
Republican challenger with no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Boyle holds a heavily Democratic Philadelphia-area seat with a large cash advantage and no meaningful opposition spending, while markets price his reelection near certain. Fundamentals support a margin in the mid-20s.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unexpectedly strong Republican fundraising push would be the main ways this becomes competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle is seeking another term in a Philadelphia-area district that leans about 19 points Democratic, and the fundamentals point to an even wider margin once incumbency and the favorable environment are counted. He has raised roughly $2.5 million and holds $5.6 million on hand, with no outside groups opposing him.

His Republican opponent, Jessica Arriaga, shows no reported fundraising, and prediction markets put Boyle's chances near 97 percent. With no public polling and no expert ratings, the race rests on these structural advantages, all of which point the same direction: a safe Democratic hold with an expected margin in the mid-20s.
